rows.grounds: sesame seed; accusative object of the preparation
instrumental oil used for cooking and anointing
thoroughly cooked; describes the sesame-oil preparation
fused tat+lepaḥ: that anointing or paste; subject of the claim
compound sthūla+liṅga+kṛt: making the penis thick; predicate

items.question: Which prepared sesame-oil anointing is said to make the penis thick?
premises: That cooked preparation is an anointing.
The anointing makes the penis thick.
items.inference: The verse prescribes a sesame-oil preparation as an anointing that thickens the penis.
uncertainties: Exact application site and dosage are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Sesame cooked in oil—its anointing—makes the penis thick.
